title: Crossy Road 创作者 Matt Hall 被任命为 Atari 移动业务执行副总裁
content:
Crossy Road creator Matt Hall named Atari's EVP of Mobile
Mobile
Business
News
Crossy Road creator Matt Hall named Atari's EVP of Mobile
One of the mobile game industry's most well-known pioneers will spearhead Atari's own foray into mobile.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
October 27, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
Hipster Whale
Newsbrief
: Atari has named Matt Haley the new executive vice-president of Mobile expansion initiatives at the company after acquiring
Hipster Whale
and Early Morning Studios.
Haley, the co-founder of Hipster Whale and creator of
Crossy Roads,
was one of the pioneers of the mobile game boom, will oversee Atari's cross-platform compatibility across engines, work with mobile partners, and build out infrastructure for Atari's mobile game expansions.
For more information, you can review
Atari's full announcement here.
